name: Infastella
dexEntry: So far this is the only of two recorded specimen of its kind. Infastella seems to have originated from the deepest parts of the cosmos. Despite being extraterrestrial, its behavior seems to be that of a small child. It can vary from being playful, shy and spends most of its time sleeping. If it's plagued by a nightmare, it will wail so loud, it feels like it's ripping the fabric of reality itself apart and can only be calmed when being near a human it truly trusts.
